orevault.configuration.title: Ore Vault
orevault.configuration.resonance.target_: Hours of hand-mining that should make the whole Resonance tree purchasable. The curve is built once when the world loads, so a change here applies the next time you load it.
orevault.configuration.resonance.curve_d: Scales the whole grind without changing the curve's shape. 2.0 halves it, 0.5 doubles it. Every skill-tree level requirement keeps its intended pacing. Applies on the next world load.
orevault.configuration.chunk_loading.vau: Whether the Vault Presence nodes work at all. Off disables cross-dimension chunk loading entirely. Does nothing yet: Vault Presence has not been built.
orevault.configuration.chunk_loading.max: Hard ceiling on chunks one team can keep loaded, whatever their node level says. 0 means unlimited, which is not recommended. Does nothing yet: the chunk loader has not been built.
orevault.configuration.ore_classificatio: Force a rarity for specific ore blocks instead of letting the classifier decide. Format: modid:block_id=common|uncommon|rare. The table is built when the world loads, so a change applies the next time you load it.
orevault.configuration.disturbed_zones.m: How many Disturbed Zone blocks one team may place. Does nothing yet: Disturbed Zones are a post-1.0 feature.
orevault.configuration.reset.allow_backu: Whether a team may export a copy of their Vault before resetting it. Does nothing yet: Vault reset has not been built.
orevault.configuration.debug.enable_debu: Unlocks /orevault diag and /orevault testore, which overwrites terrain with ore. Operator permission is still required. Applies as soon as you save, no world reload needed. Playtest tooling: leave off for normal play.
orevault.configuration.debug.log_resonan: Print a chat line each time an orb pays Resonance, showing the pool, level and progress. The only readout of the pool until the Tome exists.
node.orevault.vein_expansion.desc: Increases the size of ore veins generated in newly explored Vault chunks.
node.orevault.stone_memory.desc: Stone and deepslate drop XP and provide additional benefits at higher tiers when mined inside the Vault.
node.orevault.gravel_purge.desc: Removes gravel and clay from Vault generation in newly explored chunks.
node.orevault.miners_constitution.desc: Reduces hunger drain inside the Vault, and at higher tiers toughens the miner.
node.orevault.sure_footing.desc: The Vault's floor is a long way down and its ceiling is 69 blocks of open air. This is the node that stops that mattering.
node.orevault.deep_breath.desc: Below Y=32 the Vault stops trying to drown or burn you.
node.orevault.novices_luck.desc: The Vault is kind to people who do not know what they are doing yet.
node.orevault.apprentices_ledger.desc: The first ore of a trip is worth writing down. The hundredth is not.
node.orevault.shallow_grace.desc: While you have never been deep, the shallows pay well.
node.orevault.guide_vein.desc: A leader vein: a small, obvious deposit the Vault leaves out where a beginner will trip over it.
node.orevault.salvagers_eye.desc: Early on, even the waste rock has something in it.
node.orevault.vein_proliferation.desc: Increases the number of ore veins generated per chunk.
node.orevault.deep_veins.desc: Shifts ore generation weighting toward lower Y levels.
node.orevault.stone_reduction.desc: Replaces a portion of filler stone with ore-bearing rock, increasing ore surface area.
node.orevault.vein_shaping.desc: Decides the shape ore takes in newly generated chunks. Inert until specialized: pick one of the three Vein Shape options below and every tier of this node applies through it. All three shapes are subject to the 40% stone floor, and all three apply after Vein Expansion and Vein Proliferation, overriding the resulting count and size.
node.orevault.abundance.desc: Many small deposits scattered throughout. Reliable, steady, never a dry chunk.
node.orevault.vein_singularity.desc: All ore in a chunk is concentrated into 1–3 enormous deposits. Finding one is a jackpot; many chunks have nothing at all.
node.orevault.stratified.desc: Ore generates in flat horizontal bands sorted by rarity instead of scattered blobs. Rare ore always sits at a known depth. Rewards planned strip-mining over wandering.
node.orevault.deep_habit.desc: The longer a single trip runs, the more the Vault gives up. Rewards committing to a delve instead of hearthing out every ten minutes.
node.orevault.long_delve.desc: Time under the rock, rather than rock broken. Pays in comfort rather than yield.
node.orevault.volatile_veins.desc: Increases vein size by 25%, but each ore broken has a small chance of causing the remaining connected vein to vanish instantly, replaced with air, with no drops. A pity counter prevents more than three consecutive triggers; after three triggers the next several ore breaks are guaranteed safe. The pity counter resets on logout.
node.orevault.molten_seam.desc: Lava pools generate in the Vault's stone band, each one ringed by a two-block shell of netherrack so you always see one coming before you break into it. Ore mined near the heat comes out already smelted.
node.orevault.greedy_seams.desc: Take the material now and pay for it in progress. Ore yields double; the Vault gives back only half the Resonance.
node.orevault.resonant_overload.desc: The mirror image. Progress at double speed and take home half the material.
node.orevault.ore_attunement.desc: Decides which rarity band the Vault favours. Inert until specialized: pick Common, Uncommon or Rare Focus below and every tier of this node applies through it. Exactly one Focus at a time — the others lock until refunded, or until Full Spectrum lifts the restriction entirely.
node.orevault.common_focus.desc: Ore Attunement's tiers raise common ore vein count: +25%, then +50%, then +80%.
node.orevault.uncommon_focus.desc: Ore Attunement's tiers raise uncommon ore vein count: +25%, then +50%, then +80%.
node.orevault.rare_focus.desc: Ore Attunement's tiers raise rare ore vein count: +30%, then +60%, then +100%.
node.orevault.geode_clusters.desc: Amethyst geodes generate inside the Vault at higher frequency than the overworld.
node.orevault.ancient_traces.desc: Ancient debris generates in the Vault — but only in the deepslate band below Y=0, and the Vault refuses to multiply it.
node.orevault.ancient_knowledge.desc: Ore blocks drop bonus vanilla XP orbs in addition to standard amounts.
node.orevault.stonecutters_patience.desc: Every block of waste rock you have ever broken is worth a little more XP on the ore that follows it. Rewards tunnelling rather than only ore-hunting.
node.orevault.calloused_hands.desc: Lifetime blocks broken, on a curve that never stops rising and never runs away. Slow enough that it is a decade-long drip rather than a build.
node.orevault.vein_sight.desc: Breaking the first block of a vein outlines the rest of that vein through solid stone. You can see what you have started.
node.orevault.stonecaller.desc: The Vault's stone remembers what grows near it. Stone mined inside the Vault has a chance to convert into the ore type of the nearest vein within 8 blocks. Standing in rich rock makes even the filler pay.
node.orevault.prospectors_eye.desc: Breaking the first block of a vein briefly outlines every other vein within 16 blocks through solid stone. Turns exploratory mining into reading the rock.
node.orevault.stone_curse.desc: Stone Memory XP gain is tripled, but stone drops no items (no cobblestone, no flint, no nuggets).
node.orevault.vein_fortune.desc: Grants a passive Fortune effect to all ore mining inside the Vault. Stacks additively with tool enchantments.
node.orevault.ore_working.desc: Squeezes more out of each ore block than it contains. Inert until specialized: pick Ore Doubling or Smelter's Intuition below and every tier of this node applies through it. Vein Fortune is separate and feeds both.
node.orevault.ore_doubling.desc: Raw multiplication. Fallback order: Mekanism processing output → mod ore dust (`c:dusts/<ore>`) → extra raw ore.
node.orevault.smelters_intuition.desc: No extra material, but what you get needs no furnace. A chance that ore blocks drop the already-smelted result rather than raw ore.
node.orevault.runic_attunement.desc: Ore drops have a chance to come out **Attuned** — resonance-charged raw ore. Attuned ore is the only source of Resonance Crystals (§3.3), which every Vault Igniter upgrade and every Vault Anchor requires.
node.orevault.kindred_rock.desc: Mine enough of one thing and the Vault starts handing it to you. Every ore type is tracked separately and there is no limit on how many you can attune to.
node.orevault.highwater_mark.desc: The tool in your hand remembers how deep you have been. Ore you mine repairs it, and the deeper your record, the more it repairs.
node.orevault.brittle_stone.desc: The Vault's stone gives way at a touch — and so do its veins. Everything breaks instantly, but ore has a habit of crumbling to nothing.
node.orevault.vault_fever.desc: Grants permanent Haste II inside the Vault. You mine faster than you can listen — the Vault yields less Resonance for every ore taken.
node.orevault.vault_presence.desc: Increases the number of chunk-loading tickets the team's Vault can maintain simultaneously.
node.orevault.automated_extraction.desc: Machines mining inside the Vault extract more from each block. **Machine-broken blocks never award Resonance** (§3.4) — this node is about materials, not progression.
node.orevault.far_reach.desc: The chunks behind you stay awake for a while after you leave them, so machines keep running while you walk on.
node.orevault.seismic_sense.desc: The Tome gains a directional readout of surrounding ore density — which way the rock gets richer, at chunk granularity. Navigation rather than power.
node.orevault.wanderers_cache.desc: The Vault leaves something for people who keep walking.
node.orevault.frontier_bonus.desc: Fresh rock pays better than rock you have already been standing on.
node.orevault.pathfinders_claim.desc: Staking new ground is worth something on its own.
node.orevault.homeward_seam.desc: One anchor point, anywhere in the Vault, and a way back to it. Removes the walk-back tax that otherwise makes exploring cost more than it pays.
node.orevault.vault_keeps_it.desc: The Vault does not eat what you drop in it.
node.orevault.second_wind.desc: Once per delve, the Vault decides you are not finished.
node.orevault.second_wind_homeward.desc: The same save, but it puts you back at the portal instead of leaving you where you nearly died.
node.orevault.vaults_blessing.desc: The Vault sustains what you bring into it. Potion effects do not tick down at all while you are inside.
node.orevault.vaults_purity.desc: Nothing comes in with you. Potion effects are stripped on entry and cannot be applied inside — and the Vault rewards the discipline directly.
node.orevault.tithe.desc: 25% of ore blocks mined are consumed by the Vault (block breaks, no drop). The Resonance value of the consumed ore is multiplied by 1.75 and added to the pool. Only affects ore blocks — Stone Memory bonus drops, nuggets, flint, and other secondary sources are unaffected.
node.orevault.vault_echo.desc: When a vein is fully mined, a Resonance burst is awarded.
node.orevault.echo_chamber.desc: Vault Echo bursts also grant vanilla XP equal to the Resonance awarded. Finishing a vein becomes worth doing for its own sake rather than something that happens incidentally.
node.orevault.twin_veins.desc: When a vein is fully mined to completion, there is a chance a second identical vein spawns adjacent to the mined area with a visual flash effect.
node.orevault.last_ore.desc: The block that finishes a vein is worth more than the ones before it.
node.orevault.clean_cut.desc: Finish a vein without chewing through the rock around it.
node.orevault.vein_discipline.desc: Finish what you start, over and over, and the Vault starts expecting it of you.
node.orevault.chapters_end.desc: Clear a chunk properly and the Vault shows you what is left of it.
node.orevault.deep_harvest.desc: Ore mined below Y=0 — the deepslate band that only exists in an expanded Vault — drops an additional Resonance orb. The reward for committing to the Vault Expansion keystone.
node.orevault.resonant_draw.desc: Changes how Resonance orbs reach you. Inert until specialized: pick Resonance Magnetism or Hoarder's Instinct below and every tier of this node applies through it.
node.orevault.resonance_magnetism.desc: Orbs are drawn to the player from greater distances. Convenience — mine and never think about collection again.
node.orevault.hoarders_instinct.desc: Orbs never move toward you — but they never despawn either, and orbs that come to rest near each other merge into a single growing cache. Collecting a merged cache of N orbs pays a bonus. Rewards clearing an area completely, then sweeping it.
node.orevault.ultimine_expansion.desc: Increases the maximum number of blocks FTB Ultimine can break per operation inside the Vault.
node.orevault.ultimine_safety.desc: Reduces the Volatile Veins disappearance chance when using FTB Ultimine.
node.orevault.ultimine_gambit.desc: While Volatile Veins is active, Ultimine counts one block more toward disappearance checks. Operations that survive pay 20% more Resonance.
node.orevault.vault_expansion.desc: The Vault's floor drops away. Bedrock moves from Y=0 down to Y=−64, opening a 63-block deepslate band that carries the highest ore density in the mod. **Requires a dimension reset to take effect** — the existing Vault, and everything built in it, is regenerated.
node.orevault.full_spectrum.desc: The Vault stops favouring anything. The two focus branches you did not choose apply at half effect alongside the one you did — but the Vault's generosity is spread thin, and every ore yields less Resonance.
node.orevault.silent_stone.desc: Ore pays no Resonance at all. The pool fills instead from time spent below Y=0, faster than average mining pays.
node.orevault.resonant_symbiosis.desc: The Vault listens harder when there is more than one of you in it.
node.orevault.bedrock_communion.desc: Live at the bottom or do not bother. The deeper you are, the more the Vault gives; anywhere above the deep, the rock fights you.
node.orevault.zone_frequency.desc: Increases mob spawn frequency within Disturbed Zones.
node.orevault.zone_pack_size.desc: Increases the number of mobs per spawn attempt in Disturbed Zones.
node.orevault.zone_radius.desc: Increases the radius of each Disturbed Zone block's spawn area.
node.orevault.mob_diversity.desc: Unlocks specific mob categories that can spawn in Disturbed Zones beyond basic vanilla mobs.
node.orevault.reapers_claim.desc: Mobs killed in Disturbed Zones drop more XP.
node.orevault.corrupted_veins.desc: Mobs killed in Disturbed Zones have a chance to drop raw ore instead of standard loot.
node.orevault.plunderers_share.desc: Increases standard item drop quantity from mobs in Disturbed Zones.
node.orevault.animus_amplifier.desc: Increases Animus dropped per mob kill.
node.orevault.soul_harvest.desc: Mobs occasionally drop a Soul Harvest item on death — a separate currency usable in a future Vault Shop (to be designed). Placeholder node; shop system is a future feature.
